lines.text: | **W01 Not roused from the sleep of death** | Job 14:12 | 1 | "a man lies down and rises not again; till the heavens are no more he will not awake or be roused out of his sleep" |
| **W02 Sheol roused** | Isa 14:9 | 1 | "Sheol beneath is stirred up to meet you … it rouses the shades to greet you" |
| **W03 No breath to be woken** | Hab 2:19 | 1 | "Woe to him who says to a wooden thing, Awake … there is no breath at all in it" (the living God against the idol, LD-97) |

| **W04 God stirs up the spirit** | 1Ch 5:26; 2Ch 21:16; 2Ch 36:22; Ezr 1:1; Ezr 1:5; Hag 1:14; Jer 51:1; Jer 51:11 | 8 | "the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus"; "everyone whose spirit God had stirred to go up"; "stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel … and they came and worked"; 2Ch 21:16 "stirred up … the anger of the Philistines" |

| **W05 God stirs up a person or people** | Isa 41:2; 41:25; 45:13; 13:17; Jer 50:9; Eze 23:22; Joe 3:7; Zec 9:13 | 8 | "I have stirred him up in righteousness"; "I will stir up against you your lovers" |

| **W06 God called to awake** | Psa 7:6; 35:23; 44:23; 59:4; Isa 51:9 (×3); Psa 80:2 | 8 | "Awake! Why are you sleeping, O Lord? Rouse yourself!"; "Arise, O Lord, in your anger … awake for me"; "stir up your might and come to save us" |

| **W07 God roused, or holding back** | Zec 2:13; Isa 42:13; Psa 73:20; Psa 78:38; Job 8:6 | 5 | "he has roused himself from his holy dwelling"; "he stirs up his zeal"; "he restrained his anger often and did not stir up all his wrath" (anger link, Ch 13); Job 8:6 conditional |
| **W08 Wake yourself (the people)** | Isa 51:17 (×2); Isa 52:1 (×2) | 4 | "Wake yourself … you who have drunk … the cup of his wrath"; "Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion" |
| **W09 Rousing oneself toward God** | Isa 64:7 | 1 | "There is no one who calls upon your name, who rouses himself to take hold of you" |
| **W10 The heart awake** | Song 5:2 | 1 | "I slept, but my heart was awake" |
| **W11 Love not stirred before its time** | Song 2:7 (×2); 3:5 (×2); 8:4 (×2); 8:5 | 7 | "that you not stir up or awaken love until it pleases"; "Under the apple tree I awakened you" |

| **W12 Hatred and strife** | Pro 10:12; Job 17:8; Job 31:29; Dan 11:25 | 4 | "Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all offenses"; "the innocent stirs himself up against the godless"; "exulted when evil overtook him"; "stir up his power and his heart" |
| **W13 The ear awakened** | Isa 50:4 (×2) | 2 | "Morning by morning he awakens; he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught" |
| **W14 Awake to praise** | Psa 57:8 (×3); Judg 5:12 (×4) | 7 | "Awake, my glory! … I will awake the dawn!"; "Awake, awake, break out in a song!" |
| **W15 Woken for a vision** | Zec 4:1 (×2) | 2 | "woke me, like a man who is awakened out of his sleep" |

| **W16 Data** | Nations stirring or stirred to war (Jer 6:22; 25:32; 50:41; Joe 3:9; 3:12; Dan 11:2); weapons wielded or a sword roused (2Sa 23:18; 1Ch 11:11; 11:20; Isa 10:26; Zec 13:7); Leviathan (Job 3:8; 41:10); wind, nest, fire (Song 4:16; Deu 32:11; Hos 7:4); Isa 15:5 (raise a cry); Mal 2:12 (ESV "descendant") | 18 | Not about the inner being or about life and death |

- **The life-and-death face is small but direct.** Job 14:12 states death as a sleep from which a man is not roused "till the heavens are no more". Isa 14:9 has Sheol roused to meet the dead. Hab 2:19 sets waking against "no breath at all in it". These belong in Ch 2 ("What death is", "After death", "Breath lent").

The other Hebrew "awake" word, **H6974** (*qûṣ*), is tagged **T3**, not M25. It carries the resurrection verses: Dan 12:2 "many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake", Isa 26:19, Psa 17:15, and the first half of Job 14:12 ("he will not awake"). A cluster tag does not decide meaning (#1919). The verses that answer Job 14:12 sit outside M25. This is put to the researcher at the unit 4 ledger as a proposed addition to the unit (a strand diversion, per #1900), not decided here.
